text:
ashley: heads-up: eu-west gpu nodepool (g4dn-prod-eu) at 100% alloc. many pods Pending with "AttachVolume/AttachNetworkInterface" errors. autoscaler requested nodes but ENI attach failing. saw 5x ENIAttach failures in last 5m. :warning:

derrick: seeing the same. cloud console shows ENI quota hitting soft limit for the subnet. also several long-running research jobs (lora-sweep) created ~350 pods overnight.

ingrid: tagging as incident. can we throttle the research service or suspend the sweep?

matteo: added temporary taint to research nodepool to stop new pods landing: `kubectl taint nodes -l pool=research gpu-evict=true:NoSchedule --overwrite`

sre-bot: autoscaler-bot: canary autoscaler scaled 10 -> 40 nodes at 13:02 UTC due to pending pods (scaling events: 13:02, 13:03).

ashley: matt -- did taint evict work? any logs from kube-scheduler or CNI?

matteo: eviction started; but lots of pods are stuck Terminating waiting for CNI detach. kube-scheduler shows backoff for pod creation from the same IP pool. CNI error snippet: `failed to allocate IP: allocation exhausted for subnet eu-west-1a`.

derrick: emergency mitigation attempt: limited autoscaler max nodes to 30 to prevent uncontrolled burst, and started preempting low-priority research pods. patched cluster-autoscaler max=30.

ingrid: kicked off priority-based preemption for priorityClass=low-research; scaled down ~220 pods so far, freed ~8 GPUs. ENI attach success rate improving from 40% -> 78% in last 10m.

ashley: temporary fallback: created a small fallback nodepool in a different subnet with larger ENI headroom (label pool=fallback-eu). moved critical prod workloads there via nodeSelector and tolerations.

matteo: note on cost: fallback pool uses on-demand instances; rough delta +$1.2k/day if sustained. adding to incident cost tracker.

derrick: automation follow-ups proposed:
- throttle research sweeps via admission webhook (limit parallel pod creations per user/job)
- request subnet ENI quota bump with cloud team and add monitoring alert for attach error rate
- automate tainting + preemption when ENI attach > 20% failures over 5m
- add rate-limits to internal job scheduler

ingrid: action assignments: derrick -> open quota request ticket and follow up w/cloud (ETA 24h), ashley -> PR for admission webhook throttling, matteo -> runbook + automation for auto-taint + preempt (ETA today EOD). I'll own the postmortem doc.

ashley: thanks everyone. keeping thread open until ENI attach errors stable for 30m and pending pods drained. will post update at 14:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

(Incident summary will be added to ops/incidents with root cause: runaway lora-sweep creating mass parallel pod requests exhausts ENI pool; mitigations: preemption, taint/fallback pool, quota request, admission throttles)
